svg.title: Proof. At T = 1 each factor is the single-bit crossing, proving the sum identity. At the row split, I is the identity matrix and A = v3v⊤ 3 has eigenvalue two on v3, zero on the other three Bell vectors. For a pattern with z occurrences of 3, the eigenvalue of Bi is (−2)i(︁z i )︁. It is nonzero exactly when z ≥i. The number of such patterns is F(t, t −i). At the column split, I = v0v⊤ 0 and A = J ⊗J, where J = (︁0 1 −1 0 )︁.
